snippet.title: Monster Train 2: Destiny of the Railforged Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Monster Train 2: Destiny of the Railforged arrives on February 2, 2026! 

Lead the new Railforged clan in your battle against the Titans with this exciting new DLC for Monster Train 2, which also features a brand new game mode: Soul Savior. Free powerful Souls from the clutches of the Lifemother and her twisted children who have been trapped within the Soulstream for untold ages. 

Play Monster Train 2 NOW on PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch, and via Xbox Game Pass!

More Info: https://www.bigfangames.com/games/monster-train-2
